about.label: About
about.title: I build mobile products end-to-end
about.body1: I’m Zaid — a mobile application developer with experience shipping real-world apps using Flutter. I care about clear UI, maintainable architecture, and performance you can feel in every frame.
about.body2: My work spans UI/UX implementation, state management (Bloc), REST integration, local persistence, and Firebase-backed features. I enjoy collaborating with teams and keeping up with the latest in mobile development so every release feels modern and maintainable.

h1.d: Simple flows, strong hierarchy, and fast navigation.

h2.d: Clean structure, testable modules, and predictable state.

h3.d: Micro-interactions, performance, and attention to detail.
